violation_type.title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows Responsibilities (26 TAC §744.1013(b)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows Responsibilities
violation_type.typical_finding: The caregiver who was left in charge during the site director's absence was not aware of responsibilities as the designated person in charge.

finding_variants.text: The caregiver who was left in charge during the site director's absence was not aware of responsibilities as the designated person in charge.
The caregiver left in charge of the operation could not provide needed information during the inspection and was unaware of her responsibilities.
The caregiver who was left in charge in the site director's absence was not familiar with this site's emergency procedures.
